簡易説明 cha 160: An accident that occurred in Central Park, Motoki-cho
詳細説明 cha 1592: On April 8, Shiyo 788, in Central Park in Motoki-cho, a drunken man is said to have climbed a tree and fallen to his death. As of Shiyo 800 not many people remember it clearly, and no solid information has been obtained.

出来事名: 中央公園事故死(追加情報)
簡易説明 cha 160: Details of the accident that occurred in Central Park, Motoki-cho
詳細説明 cha 1592: On April 8, Shiyo 788, Eiichiro Niimura, Haruka Niimura's father, climbed the goshinboku in Central Park and fell to his death. He died of a heavy blow to the neck against the park fence ('a heavy blow' is what the record says, but in fact his throat was run through by a fence spike sharpened like a spear).\n　There were a great many witnesses to the accident and it is held to have no criminal aspect at all, but some apparently suspect a connection with the Megasawa City murders, which occur on the same April 8.

簡易説明 cha 160: The bizarre murders that occurred in Megasawa City, Iizawa Prefecture
詳細説明 cha 1592:
Motoki-cho, the setting of this work, belongs to Sawa Prefecture, and Megasawa City belongs to Iizawa Prefecture, west of Sawa. It was an ordinary wide-area city of about 200,000 people, but on April 8 of Shiyo 790 two elementary school children were killed by someone.
　Similar cases occurred on April 8 of Shiyo 794 and Shiyo 797, and the three together are called the Megasawa City murders. The features of the Megasawa City murders are:
・the method is not one a human being could carry out (50 meters would have to be run in 3 seconds, a 2-meter high jump would be needed, and so on)
・there are no witnesses, despite places easily seen by others
・the victims are found in an extremely ghastly state
and every time one occurs the whole of Japan is in uproar.

簡易説明 cha 160: The first bizarre murders that occurred in Megasawa City
詳細説明 cha 1592: The first bizarre murders to occur in Megasawa City. Those killed were two second graders attending an elementary school in the city. One died with the torso cut in two at a single stroke, the other beheaded. In neither case were there witnesses, and the beheaded child in particular was holding hands with both parents and standing between them, yet was beheaded all the same, an extremely abnormal situation.\n　It goes beyond what could be called a crime committed all too skillfully, and not a few people seriously believe this case was the work of a spiriting-away. Also, because those killed were children of middle-class households, it is thought that perhaps anyone would have done as the target.

簡易説明 cha 160: The second bizarre murders that occurred in Megasawa City
詳細説明 cha 1592: Bizarre murders that occurred 4 years after the first case. Those killed were a teacher in charge of the sixth grade at an elementary school in the city and the PTA president, people connected with the school the previous victims had attended. As before, there were no witnesses, no clues, and a bizarre method, and it was reported not only in Japan but around the world.\n　That the victims were connected with the same elementary school and that it had occurred on April 8 were strange points in common, and from there, internet sites that analyzed the case half in fun began to be seen.

簡易説明 cha 160: The third bizarre murders that occurred in Megasawa City
詳細説明 cha 1592: Bizarre murders that occurred 7 years after the first case and 3 years after the second. Those killed were two third-year students attending a junior high school in the city. It was also around this time that most people came to answer, when Megasawa City was mentioned, that it is the place where bizarre murders happen. Having come this far, it came to be suspected that the crimes were not by a lone culprit or a few, but by a large number of people, a crime involving the whole community, and a large-scale investigation of the whole area was carried out, but the results were not good.\n　However, because of this investigation, speculation also began to fly that a religious group long present in Megasawa City might be involved, and after the case there were also many instances of residents moving away.\n　According to a certain analysis site, the victims changed from second-grade elementary students → an adult connected with the sixth grade of elementary school → third-year junior high students, and it pointed out that the victim profile changes along with the years that pass. It concludes that if it were to occur 3 years later, in Shiyo 800, the target would likely be someone connected with the third year of high school.

出来事名: 中央公園皮剥ぎ死体事件
簡易説明 cha 160: The flayed-body case that occurred in Central Park, Motoki-cho
詳細説明 cha 1592: Early on the morning of April 8, Shiyo 800, a passerby found a badly injured person calling for help inside Central Park. An ambulance was called at once, but it did not arrive in time and the victim died. The victim appears to have been left in the park with the skin flayed from the whole body, and the strangeness of it was reported nationwide at once. The victim appears to have died when crows tore open the carotid artery.\n　Because a brutalized body was found on April 8, many suspect a connection with the earlier case in Megasawa City, Iizawa Prefecture, different place though it is, and Japan took its 4th shock.

簡易説明 cha 160: The high school girl bludgeoned to death in Motoki-cho ('Surveillance' route only)
詳細説明 cha 1592: At around 21:00 on April 8, Shiyo 800, a passerby found a high school girl collapsed near Jogaoka Nursery School, but she was already dead. The dead girl was Erina Goto, a resident of the town. Her head appears to have been crushed with what was probably a large blunt weapon.\n　Her bicycle with a flat tire and her smartphone, fallen into a drain, were nearby, and it is thought she tried to run from the culprit from that spot. There is a record of a call from her to the police just before the incident, in which she appealed about something in a flustered manner before the line was cut off.

出来事名: 二家族殺害・放火事件
簡易説明 cha 160: The murder and arson at an apartment building in Motoki-cho ('Abandonment' route only)
詳細説明 cha 1592: Just before 22:00 on April 8, Shiyo 800, a report came in that there was a fire at an apartment building in Motoki-cho, and the fire service responded at once. Erina Goto was found unconscious near the entrance. Everyone else was already dead, and because a great deal of kerosene had been poured over the living room and the kitchen gas hose had been cut, the bodies were heavily damaged. The survivor, however, was found with a blanket soaked in a great deal of water laid over her. The dead also appear to have taken fatal wounds before the fire, and these fine inconsistencies complicate the case.

簡易説明 cha 160: The killing of 2 high school girls in Motoki-cho ('Infection' route only)
詳細説明 cha 1592: (No such incident exists)

出来事名: 桜岡街道殺人未遂事件
簡易説明 cha 160: The sudden attack on 2 high school girls on the Sakuraoka road ('What I Can Do' route only)
詳細説明 cha 1592: At around 19:30 on April 8, Shiyo 800, near Sakuraoka Station in Nishisawa City, Sawa Prefecture, 2 high school girls resident in Motoki-cho were attacked by someone. The two appear to have been pursued by a figure called the 'shinigami', and Haruka Niimura was struck by a car and left unconscious in critical condition. Natsumi Kogori seems to have been unhurt, but there is much that is vague in her witness statement and no thread to the solution of the case can be seen.\n　Haruka Niimura had foreseen the shinigami's appearance and is thought to have gone to Sakuraoka to escape it, but why the shinigami appeared beside them so quickly is a mystery. Large brake marks were also left at the spot where Haruka Niimura was struck, and there is a view that this was an accident and not a murder.\n　With so many points that do not fit together for a planned killing, and with Mifuyu Niimura, who was a candidate for culprit, dead in the fire, grasping the truth will be impossible.

簡易説明 cha 160: The disappearance of Mifuyu Niimura and her daughter Haruka ('Inner Conflict' route only)
詳細説明 cha 1592: At around 19:00 on April 8, Shiyo 800, Mifuyu Niimura and Haruka Niimura jumped from the roof of the apartment building 'Rebo Heights' and went missing. A jump from the roof of a 5-story building could not normally leave anyone unhurt, yet both were gone as if they had vanished.\n　Many people saw them before the jump, however, and by their statements Mifuyu Niimura was standing on top of the fence holding a struggling Haruka Niimura in one arm. That is to say, with an astonishing sense of balance she was doing what a woman's strength could not do. She wore large red vestments, so there is speculation that she had some kind of assisting device on under them, or was using a drug that increases muscular strength.\n　There is no doubt at least that she had an astonishing sense of balance, which no drug can give, so the possibility that Mifuyu Niimura had special training cannot be denied.

簡易説明 cha 160: The case in which Akane Kogori broke into the Goto home dressed as a shinigami ('Haruka and the Witch and the Shinigami' route only)
詳細説明 cha 1592: At around 21:00 on April 8, Shiyo 800, Akane Kogori, wearing a Noh mask and red robes, broke into the Goto home through the second floor. After fighting the police who were present, she pursued Natsumi Kogori, who had fled, and encountered her in Central Park. She then died from police gunfire, but abnormal phenomena occurred: she reached a second-floor window without using a ladder, dodged bullets, and kept moving even after bullets struck her vital points. Why she broke into the Goto home in the first place is itself unknown. At the same time, Mifuyu Niimura has gone missing.

出来事名: 新村春花へのいじめ問題
簡易説明 cha 160: About the bullying Haruka Niimura suffered in Megasawa City
詳細説明 cha 1592: After the death of Eiichiro Niimura, Haruka Niimura and her family moved to Megasawa City so that her mother could be treated for a mental illness. Haruka Niimura was not yet of school age at the time, and she spent the nearly one year before starting elementary school in a children's home. There were no particular problems during this period, but when Haruka Niimura started school, Mifuyu Niimura was also discharged from the hospital, and they began living in an old rented apartment in Megasawa City.\n　However, when Haruka Niimura stood up for a classmate who was being bullied, she became the target of the bullying in turn. The homeroom teacher was aware of this and, on the teacher's own judgment, tried to work on resolving the bullying, but was pressured from elsewhere to hold back. The cause was that the parents of the children doing the bullying were apparently tied to the PTA, so the teachers could not easily step in. Because of this, Haruka Niimura herself concluded that 'no one at school will help me,' and turned to the method of cursing the children who bullied her to death.\n　As a result, through the Megasawa City case, the misfortunes that befell Haruka Niimura were wiped away one after another, and in the end, because of how eerie it was, she and her mother were advised to leave Megasawa City. The classmate Haruka Niimura had helped stopped coming to school after the Megasawa City case, and the two never saw each other again. Some also say that the classmate was bullied because the family belonged to a certain religion long established in Megasawa City.

出来事名: 呪殺編で発生した事件
簡易説明 cha 160: A rough background of the series of cases in the Jusatsu Arc [Killing by Curse]
詳細説明 cha 1592: According to Erina Goto, the series of cases that occurred in the Jusatsu Arc [Killing by Curse] (their possibility is hinted at in the Meicho Arc [Clear Sign]) came about through a bug and a GPS app planted on Haruka Niimura. With these, someone could know the situation around Haruka Niimura and where she was in real time, and could quickly set events in motion. That is why Erina Goto dirtied everything Haruka Niimura had on her so she would take it off, and made it look as if she were at home. If that reasoning holds, it also makes sense that on the sixth route of the Jusatsu Arc [Killing by Curse], Mifuyu Niimura never appeared before them because Haruka Niimura had left her smartphone at home.

出来事名: 女ケ沢市事件首謀者逮捕
簡易説明 cha 160: The case in which Mifuyu Niimura was captured at the Niimura home
詳細説明 cha 1592: Around 17:00 on April 8, Shiyo 800, at the Niimura home, an operation of posing as a corpse and as Mifuyu Niimura's mother-in-law led to the emergency arrest of the mastermind of the Megasawa City case and the Central Park flayed-body case. Judging from her attire, she is thought to have been planning to kill those then present at the Niimura home.
表示名: Arrest of the Megasawa City Case Mastermind

簡易説明 cha 160: An abnormally loud sound like scraping metal rang out across the whole of Motoki-cho
詳細説明 cha 1592: (No data)

簡易説明 cha 160: The Central Park flayed-body case (the truth)
詳細説明 cha 1592:
Mifuyu Niimura's move to Motoki-cho put the Kogori family under constant watch, so she could check that they, who had killed again and again and shared secrets neither side could reveal, never fled. Yet by her account the Arata settlement gave no direct help, so the disaster Ryoji Kogori feared for his family could never have happened, and she had no real need to watch them up close; he and the others did not think that far. Still, fleeing Motoki-cho alone would have meant leaving their real daughter Haruka Niimura to die, so they had no choice either way.
　On April 7, Shiyo 800, Ryoji Kogori asked Mifuyu Niimura to return Haruka Niimura, given up for adoption; naturally the talks broke down. Alarmed, she resolved to kill the whole Kogori family before the next card was played, timed to her husband's thirteenth-year memorial service. The flaying imitated the brutality of the Megasawa City case and carried no special message. His death from crows tearing his carotid artery was pure chance; she dumped him once he had lost the will and strength to speak.
　She thought the whole family dying together better than giving up Haruka Niimura; her first aim was to flee to the Arata settlement, which would shelter them, and failing that, to die together with her. On the Jusatsu Arc route where she burns herself to death, she does so to destroy the drug left in her body. So: Mifuyu Niimura missing = goal achieved; dead = failure.
　Yet though her family was suspected of a link to the Megasawa City case, the authorities unthinkably recommended that they move away.
表示名: The Truth of the Flaying Case

簡易説明 cha 160: A fire at Nanami-so in Megasawa City
詳細説明 cha 1592: On April 8, Shiyo 790, a fire broke out at 'Nanami-so,' an apartment building in Nanami-cho, Megasawa City. The Kogori family, apart from Natsumi Kogori, and the Niimura family died at the hands of Mifuyu Niimura. Mifuyu Niimura set the fire just before her death to destroy evidence of the drug provided by the Arata settlement. Natsumi Kogori's life was spared because 'it would be a problem if she came over to this side,' but she suffered a severe shock to her heart and has lived in a facility for the 10 years since.

簡易説明 cha 160: The truth of the Megasawa City case (Wabigoto Arc)
詳細説明 cha 1592:
Laid out in chronological order, the Megasawa City case came about as follows:
・Eiichiro Niimura dies, and Mifuyu Niimura and the others move to Megasawa City
・Haruka Niimura is bullied
・Mifuyu Niimura gives Haruka Niimura the book of curses
・Once she confirms Haruka Niimura has cast the curse, the plan is carried out
・The tools are ordered from the Arata settlement, and a letter is put directly into the Kogori home's mailbox
・The Kogori couple, come to Megasawa City, are threatened until no choice but carrying it out remains
・The killings are carried out
　Only with these elements intertwined, 'an alibi set up at the funeral,' 'the involvement of the Arata settlement' and 'threats exploiting a weakness,' did it become possible.

簡易説明 cha 160: A case in which a prefectural employee was killed with a blade by someone
詳細説明 cha 1592: In Shiyo 750, Tsutomu Kanezaki, a prefectural employee, was killed on the street near his home in Iizawa City, Iizawa Prefecture. Police made an emergency arrest of Nobuhiro Shikishima, who was at the scene, on suspicion of murder. Shikishima was sitting beside Kanezaki's body and reportedly showed no sign of resisting even when the police arrived. Under questioning Shikishima stayed silent, and his motive and how the killing came about are unknown. No records remain of what verdict was handed down afterward either.\n　According to the investigation, Kanezaki showed a virtuous face but was believed to have ties with organized crime, and was rumored to be secretly running illegal land-sharking. Prosecutors suspected that Shikishima had been swindled out of his land by Kanezaki and acted out of that grudge, but whether this is true is likewise unknown. Kanezaki's subordinates were also seen entering the Arata district, which is state-owned land, and he is thought to have been trying to obtain the land around it by illegal means as well.\n　Whether residents of the Arata settlement were involved in the case is unknown, but Erika Niimura, who had been told to kill Kanezaki, was allowed to marry in through this case without doing the deed herself.

出来事名: 女子高生飛び込み自殺
簡易説明 cha 160: A case in which a high school girl was hit by a train and killed at Motoki Station
詳細説明 cha 1592: In the summer of Shiyo 796, a high school girl threw herself in front of a train at Motoki Station. There were many witnesses and no foul play is suspected, but in Motoki-cho, where such events are rare, it was reportedly the talk of the town for some time. From around then, a story arose of a ghost appearing at Motoki Station, and for a while stories tying it to Motokizakura-sama were popular. But within a few months the event faded, and since then townspeople only bring it up now and then as ghost-story material, as if suddenly remembering it.
表示名: A High School Girl's Suicide by Train

簡易説明 cha 160: A case in which a family of four is said to have died near the summit of Mount Motoki
詳細説明 cha 1592: In Shiyo 785, a suspicious car is seen parked near the summit of Mount Motoki. Inside, a family of four living in Motoki-cho had all died. So begins the novel 'Catharsis of the Cherry Blossom Town,' written by an author living in Motoki-cho. Sales were sluggish, however; only about 1,000 copies were bought, mostly by Motoki-cho residents, and it was never reprinted. Hoping to create even a little buzz, the author borrowed the Motokizakura-sama urban legend and made up the ghost story Natsumi Kogori told. Even so, sales never grew, and only the urban legend spread through Motoki-cho, changing shape in amusing ways.
表示名: The Strange Deaths of a Family

簡易説明 cha 160: A case in which Sakura Niimura fell to her death from a cliff on the edge of the Arata settlement
詳細説明 cha 1592: On April 17, Shiyo 790, Sakura Niimura, a resident of the Arata settlement, fell from a cliff and died. At first eyewitness accounts suggested suicide, but the body that was found had been beheaded, so it is thought that someone pushed her off the cliff and then beheaded her, or went out of their way to behead a suicide's body.

簡易説明 cha 160: A series of events in which old people of the Arata settlement kill themselves
詳細説明 cha 1592: The people who live in the Arata settlement all show the peculiar tendency to die in April. Before the war nearly all of them died of illness, but from the Shiyo 730s suicides began to increase. Why this happens is unknown, but theories include an endemic disease that makes people suicidal, or murder disguised as suicide.

簡易説明 cha 160: A case in which Natsumi Kogori was killed by a group thought to be Arata settlement residents
詳細説明 cha 1592: On April 8, Shiyo 800, Natsumi Kogori, who had come to the Arata settlement, was attacked by a group wearing red robes and Noh masks. She, however, has no idea why she had to be killed. Just before, Kana Niimura, fatally wounded, said "Chigaya Niimura betrayed me" and died, and Chigaya Niimura was also killed by the group in red robes and Noh masks. How this came about is a mystery, but the group called Natsumi Kogori "the witch who brings the curse," so it is thought something made them see her as some kind of threat.

簡易説明 cha 160: The event in which Kotaro Niimura was placed under watch to prove his innocence in the curse-killing cases
詳細説明 cha 1592: Kotaro Niimura, the top suspect in the curse-killing cases, offered to the residents to have himself watched during April to prove his own innocence. Even though he was constantly being watched in the meeting hall, curse-killing cases occurred for 3 years, and Kotaro Niimura's innocence seems to have been proven. However, this method means that his innocence can be proven if a curse-killing case occurs while he is being watched, and, looked at the other way, it is not proven if no curse-killing case occurs. In other words, it can be said that Kotaro Niimura proved his innocence at the sacrifice of other people's lives, and if the aim was to solve the curse-killing cases, it can also be seen as an all too short-sighted and rash decision. In any case, this led to the residents' mutual distrust being stirred up over which of them was the culprit.

簡易説明 cha 160: A case in which Kikyo Niimura, the Grand Witch at the time, died in February
詳細説明 cha 1592: In Shiyo 735, Kikyo Niimura, then serving as Grand Witch, died. Arata settlement residents invariably die in April, but Kikyo Niimura died in February. Because of this, Kikyo Niimura was deemed not one of the settlement's people, and her family was apparently killed as well. However, no concrete records from that time remain, and no one alive then is still living, so there is no accurate information. To begin with, 'illness' is recorded as the cause, but whether it truly was illness is doubtful. Why Kikyo Niimura died in February, whether her family was really killed, and so on: now only what Erika Niimura heard as rumors is known.

簡易説明 cha 160: A case in which the residents of the Arata settlement killed one another
詳細説明 cha 1592: On April 7, Shiyo 800, a case occurred in which Kana Niimura and the residents of the Arata settlement fought to kill each other (both sides used Droga). Kana Niimura struggled to protect Natsumi Kogori and the others, but was mortally wounded and passed away as Erina Goto watched over her. The mastermind is thought to be Kotaro Niimura, but his aim apparently was to capture Natsumi Kogori alive, which differs somewhat from the situation when Natsumi Kogori was killed in another route. In any case, Kotaro Niimura seems to have had some intention, but in the end its purpose remains unclear.
表示名: The Mass Murder in the Arata Settlement

簡易説明 cha 160: The disappearance of Erina Goto
詳細説明 cha 1592: Erina Goto went to the Arata settlement and never came back, and her whereabouts are unknown. Her older sister, Momoko Goto, made posters and gathered information to search for her younger sister, but 4 years later, as of Shiyo 804, a half-rotted poster was left pinned to a bulletin board. Whether Erina Goto was found, or whether her whereabouts are still unknown, is not certain.

簡易説明 cha 160: An attack by the residents that took place on the Arata mountain road
詳細説明 cha 1592: After seeing the note that Kengo Shirozaki apparently handed over during the thirteenth-year memorial service, Natsumi Kogori and the others at once try to escape the Arata settlement. On the way they are attacked by residents wearing Noh masks and red robes, but thanks to Chigaya Niimura and Kana Niimura, who were acting as guards, no one is injured. However, the mountain road is blocked by a huge fallen tree, so they have no choice but to turn back to the settlement and take refuge in the secret base. The residents moved inhumanly, leaping more than 3 meters, so they are believed to have been using Droga.
表示名: The Attack on the Arata Mountain Road

簡易説明 cha 160: Kotaro Niimura's violent rampage in the third route of the Shigatsu Arc
詳細説明 cha 1592: Natsumi Kogori, Haruka Niimura and Erina Goto, who had taken refuge underground, are nearly killed by Kotaro Niimura, but a string of what seem to be 'coincidences' piles up, and they escape the Arata settlement safely. The residents who used Droga were already battered all over, and were subdued by Erika Niimura and the others; not a single person died.

簡易説明 cha 160: The death of Erika Niimura from illness
詳細説明 cha 1592: On May 3, Shiyo 800, Erika Niimura, head of the Arata settlement, died of a heart attack. She was 71. That is relatively short-lived in a settlement where most of the elderly live to 75, when they take their own lives, but she seems to have pushed herself hard in body and mind through the 10 years of curse-killings and the April 8 attack, and these are thought to have shortened her life. To begin with, nearly everyone in the Arata settlement had died in April, so she can also be called someone who escaped the settlement's strange phenomenon.

簡易説明 cha 160: Erina Goto deduces that the culprit of the curse-killings is Chigaya Niimura
詳細説明 cha 1592: Erina Goto had her eye on Chigaya Niimura as the real culprit of the curse-killings. She reasoned that Chigaya Niimura, having lost her mother early, feared losing any more of her family, and so killed, year after year, the residents who treated her father, Kotaro Niimura, as the culprit. Chigaya Niimura did not deny it, and intimidated Erina Goto. Chigaya Niimura then let out words close to a confession, but she also said that she "had wanted to kill her mother too." With this, Erina Goto realized that her deduction had been wrong in every respect, and she also sensed the identity of someone lurking behind it all. She was furious at whoever had torn her pride to shreds so thoroughly, and swore in her heart that she would expose the identity of the one lurking behind it all without fail.

簡易説明 cha 160: The incident in which Haruka Niimura stabbed Natsumi Kogori to death
詳細説明 cha 1592: Haruka Niimura suddenly stabs Natsumi Kogori to death with a knife. No one knows her motive or how it came about, and Erina Goto, who witnessed the whole thing, went beyond stunned until laughter welled up in her. Coming back to herself, Haruka Niimura was at once taken to the police by Mifuyu Niimura and Erina Goto, but unable to accept what she had done and the loss of Natsumi Kogori, she escaped reality by 'fainting and fleeing into a dream world.'\n　This Haruka Niimura is Mika Tachiki's true identity, and in the dream she was looking back on the path she had taken and the chain of events that went with it. In other words, the real Haruka Niimura is unconscious, and unless the Haruka Niimura who fled into the dream world tries to return to her own world, she will never wake again.

簡易説明 cha 160: A forest fire that broke out in the Arata district
詳細説明 cha 1592: On Shiyo 804, April 8, a forest fire broke out in the Arata district. Firefighters rushed to the scene at once, but by then the fire was already dying down. However, most of the residents had burned to death, some bodies appeared to have been shot, and Momoko Goto, the only one with no burns from the fire, was named as a suspect. Momoko Goto is believed to have shot herself with a handgun she had been carrying, and how the fire and the killings came about is unknown.\n　According to the driver of the train Momoko Goto rode, she had shared the ride with two residents of the Arata settlement the day before the fire and chatted with them, so Momoko Goto was thought to have some connection to the Arata settlement. In fact it was the opposite: her plan notebook held notes for destroying the Arata settlement, and it is surmised that she won the residents over to make the settlement easier to destroy, and once they trusted her, shot them all dead at once.\n　However, once it emerged that one of Momoko Goto's eyes was green, the National Police Agency promptly ordered the investigation closed, and Momoko Goto's body was quickly taken away to headquarters. The case was never investigated again and is fading from people's memories. How Momoko Goto's body was disposed of is also unknown.

簡易説明 cha 160: Erina Goto and Chigaya Niimura win the Nobel Peace Prize
詳細説明 cha 1592: In Shiyo 814, Erina Goto and Chigaya Niimura were recognized for their achievements as philanthropists and received that year's Nobel Peace Prize. Yet Erina Goto's speech conveyed no joy or sense of honor at the award; she said, 'This prize is our punishment and our sin.' Their charity work is not for others or for the world, but merely to make amends for themselves, to cover the pain of having failed to save those they could not help; the two think of it as hypocrisy, and of themselves as selfish cowards.\n　Since it began after the two, who had excelled in eating contests, were criticized for wasting food, both the start of their charity work and its continuation can indeed be seen as serving their own ends. Still, the lives saved by their work are by no means few, and even if they cannot accept their own good deeds, the results are truly worthy of the Nobel Peace Prize.\n　Thus how they judge themselves and how others judge them do not always agree: the more lives they save, the higher others rate them, and that praise becomes, for them, punishment and sin, a widening mismatch. How long they can bear this punishment and sin is uncertain, but in any case, somewhere today a life they save will surely be grateful to them.

シナリオ名: サード・ジェネレーション
出来事名: 予知能力による犯人逮捕
簡易説明 cha 160: Mifuyu Niimura's arrest, brought about by Erina Goto's danger sense
詳細説明 cha 1592: Touched by a tiny amount of Natsumi Kogori's blood, Erina Goto foresaw several days' worth of dangers in a very short time. At first she took it not for a premonition but for reality, but when she came to, it was still April 8; she explained to Mifuyu Niimura the terrible things that were about to happen and persuaded her. Haruka Niimura, who happened to ride by on her bicycle, came face to face with Mifuyu Niimura and told her she would remain Mifuyu Niimura's daughter no matter what. In the end Mifuyu Niimura turned herself in, and Kotaro Niimura and Sakura Niimura, thought to have been complicit in the Megasawa City case, were arrested as well. However, just how Kotaro Niimura and the others were involved in the Megasawa City case never came to light, and whether they were found guilty is uncertain.

簡易説明 cha 160: Haruka Niimura, in a coma, recovers and leaves the hospital
詳細説明 cha 1592: Haruka Niimura, who had remained unconscious in a vegetative state, wakes for the first time in 2 years. Why she woke is unknown, but in the doctors' view, having become green-eyed, she was seized by murderous intent toward Natsumi Kogori and thrashed about despite being unconscious (the doctors did not know how she came to have green eyes or what caused the murderous intent, and their treatment was mostly symptomatic), and that movement may have stimulated her body and brain until she awoke. Her murderous intent toward Natsumi Kogori subsided thanks to the exchange transfusion, and from now on the two will surely live happily together as sisters.

シナリオ名: パラサイト・プリズン
簡易説明 cha 160: A massive earthquake disaster that struck Motoki City
詳細説明 cha 1592: Around 10:30 a.m. on Shiyo 815, April 6 (Fri.), an earthquake of magnitude 5 occurred with its focus in Motoki City. Although Motoki City recorded an intensity of 7 (estimated), the magnitude was relatively small, so the focus is thought to have been very shallow. Immediately afterward, several giant cherry trees sprang up in Motoki City, and toxic gas of unknown origin filled the city. There is thought to be no hope that the people in Motoki City at the time survived.\n　A survey team was dispatched, but not one of its members came back, and the government designated a 100 km radius around the epicenter a permanent no-entry zone. Since then, survey teams from various countries have entered from time to time, but for at least 65 years, no one has come back.\n　Right after the disaster, the government announced that "there are no survivors," which stirred up distrust and anxiety among the public, but since no one who actually went into Motoki City ever came back, the soundness of the government's judgment gradually came to be accepted. Even so, as of Shiyo 900, no small number of people remain curious about what has become of Motoki City, and some kind of investigation will likely continue from here on.

シナリオ名: メガミゴロシミナゴロシ
簡易説明 cha 160: The suicide of the girl who first developed green eyes
詳細説明 cha 1592: Killing by someone with green eyes is called the 'Green-Eye Curse-Killing.' Its origin is Tomi, a girl who lived in the settlement around Shiyo 352. Tomi was born with odd eyes: one eye was black, and the other was green. One day she suddenly falls into a frenzy, and before the residents come to harm, she thrusts her hand through her eye into her brain and kills herself.\n　Because of the Arata Incident, the residents of the time had been unable to decide how to treat green-eyed people, but this event gave rise to the phrase the curse of the green eyes, that is, the 'Green-Eye Curse-Killing,' and the rule 'If a girl with green eyes is born, kill her' came to be handed down to later generations.\n　Meanwhile, Tomi's body was enshrined as a goddess who had resisted the Green-Eye Curse-Killing and saved the settlement, and it was preserved as a mummy by the descendants of the Westerners. For her name, too, she was given 'Verde,' which means green in Portuguese.

シナリオ名: メガミゴロシミナゴロシ
簡易説明 cha 160: The National Police Agency orders the Arata settlement closed and off-limits
詳細説明 cha 1592: Early on the morning of Shiyo 802, April 9, the police rushed to the Arata settlement at Erina Goto's request, but every resident, Erina Goto included, was confirmed dead. Taking the situation seriously, the government and the National Police Agency closed off the Arata settlement and are putting their efforts into solving the case. However, no outsider who knew the people of the settlement has ever been permitted to enter, and the case is believed to be, in effect, being covered up.　Most likely Haruka Niimura, the only survivor, does not even know this, and will end her life deep in the mountains, out of sight of anyone.
表示名: The Closing of the Arata Settlement

年月日: The year before the Shiyo era, April 9
簡易説明 cha 160: A rebellion against Tara no Kiyomori that broke out around the year before the Shiyo era began
詳細説明 cha 1592: The Prince's uprising took place one year before Shiyo 1, in the year before the Shiyo era began: the Prince, the Emperor's elder brother, and Minato no Tsunamune planned to raise an army to overthrow the Tara clan, and issued the Prince's decree urging the Minato clan in the provinces and the great temples and shrines to rise up. Tara no Kiyomori, who held power at the time, had severely restricted even the Emperor's authority, imprisoned the Prince's father and confiscated the Prince's lands, and the Prince could not endure such humiliating circumstances. The uprising was soon put down, but it was the event that set off the Tara clan's later ruin.

簡易説明 cha 160: People begin living in what is now the Arata district of Iizawa Prefecture
詳細説明 cha 1592: The Arata settlement began when the Prince, driven from the capital after his uprising, his friend Minato no Tsunamune and their retainers began to live in the untamed land they had reached. They had originally been heading east from the capital to rely on Minato no Tomoyori, but to escape the eyes of their pursuers they deliberately took the long way around, crossing steep mountains as well. Many lost their lives along the way, but they spent those lives to keep the Prince alive.\n　In the end, while resting in the land of Arata, they were drawn by its fertility and charm, cast off their rank, and all decided to put down roots here. At first, since it was a land like heaven, they nearly named it 'Amata,' heaven's field, but because invaders drawn by such a name would be a nuisance, they deliberately gave it 'Arata,' a name that rhymes with it.\n　Incidentally, the family name Niimura―'new village'―also comes from this 'arata na mura,' a new village, where 'arata' is both Arata and 'new.'
表示名: The Founding of the Arata Settlement

簡易説明 cha 160: が集落を旅立った同日、住人であった糸姫が失踪。荒田文化成立のきっかけとなる
詳細説明 cha 1592: 身分を捨てた皇子が日本をよりよくするために、荒田で培った開墾の技術を全国に伝えようと旅立った。彼に恋焦がれていた従者の糸姫は彼を追い集落の外れで再会するも、この地で待つように説得され、彼女も皇子の帰りを待つと心に決めた。しかし、糸姫は皇子と別れた直後に山賊に追われ、崖から転落する。死体に寄生する性質のある菌類『死月妖花』に肉体を乗っ取られた彼女は互いの利害の一致のために不老の力を得、また死月妖花がより繁殖できるよう手助けをする。\n　一方、糸姫の失踪を知った住人は糸姫が転落死した跡を見つけ（遺体は見つかっていない）、近くにいた山賊たちを皆殺しにする。この時から外部に対して異常なまでの警戒心を持つようになり、近づく者は迷い人でない限り殺害された。今でこそ現代的な気質になっているものの、荒田集落の根底にはこのような部外者に対する警戒心が残っているのである。

簡易説明 cha 160: The battle in which Enei Ouda took the head of Motoyoshi Magawa
詳細説明 cha 1592: A battle fought between Enei Ouda and Motoyoshi Magawa on Shiyo 310, June 12. Motoyoshi Magawa, who was aiming to march on the capital, set out to invade the Ouda house, but was hit by a surprise attack and lost his head as commanding general, and Enei Ouda won a dramatic victory. Having won this battle, Enei Ouda rapidly expanded his power. However, there are many theories about the truth of this battle, and opinion is divided on questions such as why Enei Ouda was able to win and whether a battle really took place at Taruhazama at all.

簡易説明 cha 160: A battle at the Arata settlement, thought to have been a forest fire and internal strife
詳細説明 cha 1592: Internal strife witnessed on Shiyo 348, April 5, by Yasuie Togawa, who had been ordered by Fujiyoshiro to transport the cherry trees, when he visited the Arata settlement. When he arrived at the settlement alone, ahead of the rest, to see the state of the forest fire, the residents were moving about as if nothing were wrong despite mortal wounds, and killing one another with physical strength that seemed more than human. Yasuie was certain this was the work of Droga. Yoshiro had prepared the pretext of the Godai hanami as a cover so that he could keep the Droga made from the Arata cherries close at hand.\n　Meanwhile, the residents who survived this crisis came to suspect one another, and the settlement, harsh enough on outsiders already, became wary even of neighbors. To overcome this, every resident was made to attend every wedding, funeral and other ceremonial occasion, and the strange customs performed there were shared as a secret (the customs themselves held nothing much worth hiding; by a reasoning that put the cart before the horse, the aim was simply to keep the customs themselves from leaking outside).\n　Yet fear once experienced is not easily wiped away, and though they say 'One for all, all for one,' in their hearts they think, 'The only one who can protect me is me.'

簡易説明 cha 160: A grand hanami held by Fujiyoshiro
詳細説明 cha 1592: A cherry-blossom viewing banquet that Fujiyoshiro held at Godaiji in the capital on Shiyo 340, April 20, in the very last years of his life. A grand event at which he summoned his close relatives and, from the daimyo, about 1,300 of their ladies-in-waiting and maidservants.\n　It is also said that the head priest who had restored Godaiji, left in ruins after the turmoil of the warring age, had won Yoshiro's devotion and built good relations with him, and, sensing that Yoshiro's end was near, quietly made arrangements here and there to set up a great stage worthy of the last days of a splendid hero of his age, and so brought this Godai hanami about. Yoshiro died about 5 months later.

簡易説明 cha 160: The event in which the existence of Shigatsu Youka was first set down in writing
詳細説明 cha 1592:
The exact date is not known, but around Shiyo 480, an incident occurred that drove the Arata settlement to the brink of destruction. According to the records, a cherry called Shigatsu Youka and 'the Fierce Sound' seem to have been involved. The specifics of the incident are not recorded either; all that is known is that the following apparently took place:
・A cherry tree as gigantic as a mountain appeared
・The dead of the past came back to life
・The dead killed the living
・The source of the evil could be driven off, but not destroyed
This incident gave rise to the concepts that symbolize the settlement's present-day culture, such as 'shinigami,' 'Noh masks' and 'red robes,' and how the incident arose and how it was resolved is unknown.

出来事名: 新村栄一郎のドローガ実験
簡易説明 cha 160: Eiichiro Niimura makes Droga and tests it on himself
詳細説明 cha 1592: To put an end to the bullying of Sakura Niimura, Eiichiro Niimura reaches a rather extreme conclusion for him―an eye for an eye, violence for violence―and makes Droga. Such violence hardly suits his character, but his wish to protect Sakura Niimura must have been that strong. He succeeds in making Droga, but he cannot control its side effects, the elation and excitement, and shatters the rock in front of him with a kick. In exchange, he suffers a compound fracture of the leg. At that moment Sakura Niimura, trying to stop the bleeding, is drenched head-on in his (first-generation) blood and infected, becoming the second generation.\n　The root of the flayed-body case in Motoki-cho and the series of curse-killings can be said to lie in this self-righteous act of Eiichiro Niimura's.

簡易説明 cha 160: Chigaya Niimura's Green-Eye Curse-Killing
詳細説明 cha 1592:
A few days before the Megasawa City case, Chigaya Niimura has her first period and meets the conditions for the Green-Eye Curse-Killing. While Sakura Niimura is doing a danger reading for Kotaro Niimura, she comes face to face with Chigaya Niimura, and the Green-Eye Curse-Killing sets in. Chigaya is locked in the underground storeroom for several days. To treat the Green-Eye Curse-Killing, the safety of falsificaso has to be tested, so Kotaro Niimura sends Droga and falsificaso to Mifuyu Niimura. Here the story branches on whether the Megasawa City case happens. If the Droga is used, the Megasawa City case occurs and the story goes on to the Jusatsu Arc and Meicho Arc routes; if not, it proceeds to the Shigatsu Arc and the Eden no Sakura Arc. In other words,
・Megasawa City case occurs = Sakura Niimura survives, Chigaya Niimura's green eyes are treated
・Megasawa City case prevented = Sakura Niimura dies, Chigaya Niimura's green eyes are left untreated
is how it plays out.
　If the Megasawa City case occurs, falsificaso is judged to have no toxicity and is given to Chigaya Niimura; if not, Sakura Niimura gives it to herself and throws away her precognition. Either way, giving falsificaso seems to have done the human body no noticeable harm.

出来事名: 新村サクラ首切り事件
簡易説明 cha 160: The Sakura Niimura beheading case
詳細説明 cha 1592: On Shiyo 790, April 17, Sakura Niimura suddenly runs out of the house. Every adult in the settlement is called out to search, but the first to find her is Erika Niimura, just as Sakura Niimura is about to jump from the cliff. When Sakura Niimura jumps, Erika Niimura tries to pull her up, but in vain, and she falls. Right after, Kotaro Niimura cuts off the head of the fallen Sakura Niimura. This stages an inexplicable case, and the fact that Erika Niimura 'pushed her off' is buried. It also seems meant to make it harder for Erika Niimura to speak of what happened, since it was her own son who cut off the head. But Chigaya Niimura witnessed that very moment, and afraid of losing any more of her family, she kept the whole story of the beheading case to herself for 10 years. Still, it is puzzling that a husband in what should have been a devoted marriage would suddenly decide on the spot to cut off his wife's head, and that he had a nata ready that could cut off a head. Note that at this time no one was left inside the settlement.

簡易説明 cha 160: The case in which Chigaya Niimura killed a resident of the Arata settlement every year
詳細説明 cha 1592: The culprit behind the curse-killings that took place in the Arata settlement in the past was Chigaya Niimura, who killed residents who were about to accuse Kotaro Niimura of being the murderer. She feared losing her family after Sakura Niimura's death. She killed off those who would cause that, but after Kotaro Niimura's confinement, distrust spread among the residents, until at last killings happened even without her lifting a hand.　But while Chigaya Niimura claims she killed her targets with the knife she was used to, the actual bodies had been bludgeoned to death, and for the first time she questions whether she really committed the crimes.

出来事名: 豊岳線の運転見合わせ
簡易説明 cha 160: The Toyotake Line suspended by a cherry tree that suddenly sprang up
詳細説明 cha 1592: A cherry tree suddenly grows on the tracks at Toyotake Station. Naturally, there was no sign of it at all until moments before, and the scene is thrown into an uproar. Because of this, Natsumi Kogori and the others lose one of their ways back to Motoki-cho, but Natsumi Kogori says, "If this keeps up, Motoki-cho is going to disappear."

出来事名: 御神木研究チームの惨殺
簡易説明 cha 160: The massacre of the goshinboku research team in Shiyo 747
詳細説明 cha 1592: In Shiyo 747, a public research team was formed to study the cherry tree that had suddenly grown in Motoki-cho. But a few days later, every one of the researchers was dead, their heads smashed in. It is thought that some higher authority existed that sought to let the case fade from memory by overwriting it with the fishy-sounding urban legend of Motokizakura-sama. In other words, research on the goshinboku had already been going on before then, and it is presumed they had a rough idea of what it really is.

簡易説明 cha 160: 呪殺事件の真相
詳細説明 cha 1592: 呪殺事件は、死月妖花が人間を荒田集落から追い払うために引き起こされたもの。老人の自殺の延長であるが、老人の自殺だけでは効果が見られなかったのでより恐怖を煽(あお)る殺人事件に切り替えた。また死亡した新村サクラを使役して集落内に2名のスパイ（新村幸太郎、新村茅萱）を仕立て、より事件を超自然的な現象に見せかけた。この呪殺事件はスパイ2人の新村サクラへの情愛があることが前提条件であり、そこが破たんすれば呪殺事件はたちまち真相にたどり着かれる状態であった。
